title: [Android] Export project as an Android Archive (AAR)

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

The Android export preset currently supports the ability to export a Godot project as an Android package ([APK](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apk_(file_format))) or as an Android App Bundle ([AAB](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_App_Bundle)). 

This PR adds the Android Archive ([AAR](https://developer.android.com/studio/projects/android-library)) as another export format, allowing a Godot project to be bundled within an Android archive so it can be exported and embedded within another Android project.

To do so, this PR updates the layout of the [`app` module](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/engine_details/development/configuring_an_ide/android_studio.html#building-debugging-the-app-module). The `app` module is an Android application module, meaning it has the ability to create `APK` and `AAB` binaries. 
An Android application module can depend on an [Android library module](https://developer.android.com/studio/projects/android-library#CreateLibrary), allowing it to incorporate the library's functionality at build time. In addition, Android library modules can export `AAR` binaries, allowing other libraries or applications to depend on them via the generate `AAR` binary.

This PR introduces the `:app:dataLib` library module as a dependency of the `:app` module, and migrate most of the `:app` module (code, manifest, resources, assets) to it. The build flow for creating `APK` and `AAB` binaries is unchanged given the new dependency ensures the `:app` module generated binaries end up with the same content as with the previous module layout.
However the migration of the `:app` module code to the `:app:dataLib` module means that now we can also generate `AAR` binaries with the same logic.

**Note:** 
- When exporting a Godot project as an `AAR`, an additional `aar_deps` folder is created in the target export directory containing other `AAR` binaries provided by the project's plugins, as those cannot be merged directly with the generated project `AAR`. 
- The first commit update the Android gradle plugin to version `8.13.2` which is required for some of the new capabilities we're using. The bulk of the changes is in the second commit.
